title: Design QA: Graph canvas-first redesign
summary: Design QA report comparing Maru's canvas-first graph redesign to an Obsidian reference; all rubric criteria pass after two iterations and an adversarial pass.
notes: No frontmatter, no numbered/typed filename convention. PASS-marked rubric lines superficially resemble PRD acceptance criteria, but they record verification results of an already-shipped implementation rather than stating requirements; no decision statement, no schema/contract. Resolved to DOC (context only). Output filename uses a path-derived suffix instead of a SHA-256 prefix because no shell tool was available to compute the digest; the directory component provides the same sibling-collision guarantee.
